theory.intro: To compare lengths fairly, first write them in the **same unit**. Then the numbers can be compared directly.
facts: You cannot compare the numbers $1.2$ and $90$ directly when the lengths are $1.2$ m and $90$ cm. First use the same unit.
Useful links: $1$ m $= 100$ cm, $1$ cm $= 10$ mm, $1$ km $= 1000$ m.
Convert to a common unit of your choice. A smaller unit often avoids decimals, but keep the exact measurements when comparing.
steps: Choose one common unit for all the lengths.
Convert every length into that unit.

workedExamples.question_text:
a. Which ribbon is longer: $1.37$ m or $139$ cm?
b. A student says $1370$ mm is longer than $1.37$ m because $1370>1.37$. Correct the claim.
workedExamples.solution_text:
a. Use centimetres.
$1.37\times100=137$
$1.37\text{ m}=137\text{ cm}$
$137\text{ cm}<139\text{ cm}$
The $139$ cm ribbon is longer.
b. Use millimetres.
$1.37\times100\times10=1370$
$1.37\text{ m}=1370\text{ mm}$
The lengths are equal. Compare the numbers only after using the same unit.

workedExamples.question_text: Order these walking routes from shortest to longest: $1.238$ km, $1260$ m, $1$ km $245$ m and $1.251$ km.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Use metres for all four routes.
$1.238\times1000=1238$
$1.238\text{ km}=1238\text{ m}$
$1\text{ km }245\text{ m}=1000\text{ m}+245\text{ m}=1245\text{ m}$
$1.251\times1000=1251$
$1.251\text{ km}=1251\text{ m}$
$1238<1245<1251<1260$
Shortest to longest: $1.238\text{ km},\ 1\text{ km }245\text{ m},\ 1.251\text{ km},\ 1260\text{ m}$.

workedExamples.question_text: Which lengths are greater than $1.5$ m: $149$ cm, $1500$ mm, $1.503$ m and $0.00152$ km?
workedExamples.solution_text:
Use millimetres, including for the $1.5$ m comparison length.
$1.5\text{ m}=1.5\times1000\text{ mm}=1500\text{ mm}$
$149\text{ cm}=149\times10\text{ mm}=1490\text{ mm}$
$1.503\text{ m}=1.503\times1000\text{ mm}=1503\text{ mm}$
$0.00152\text{ km}=0.00152\times1000\text{ m}=1.52\text{ m}$
$1.52\text{ m}=1.52\times1000\text{ mm}=1520\text{ mm}$
$1490<1500$, $1500=1500$, $1503>1500$ and $1520>1500$.
The lengths greater than $1.5$ m are $1.503$ m and $0.00152$ km. The $1500$ mm length is equal, so it is not included.

foundation.question_text: Which is longer: a $1.4$ m skipping rope or a $135$ cm skipping rope?
foundation.solution_text:
$1.4\text{ m}=140\text{ cm}$
$140\text{ cm}>135\text{ cm}$
The $1.4$ m rope is longer.

foundation.question_text: Which ribbon is longer: $95$ mm or $8$ cm?
foundation.solution_text:
$8\text{ cm}=80\text{ mm}$
$95\text{ mm}>80\text{ mm}$
The $95$ mm ribbon is longer.

foundation.question_text: Which rope is longer: $2.6$ m or $255$ cm?
foundation.solution_text:
$2.6\text{ m}=260\text{ cm}$
$260\text{ cm}>255\text{ cm}$
The $2.6$ m rope is longer.

foundation.question_text: Which walking route is longest: $0.9$ km, $850$ m or $1100$ m?
foundation.solution_text:
$0.9\text{ km}=900\text{ m}$
$1100\text{ m}>900\text{ m}>850\text{ m}$
The $1100$ m route is longest.

foundation.question_text: Which plant is tallest: $42$ cm, $390$ mm or $0.4$ m?
foundation.solution_text:
$390\text{ mm}=39\text{ cm}$
$0.4\text{ m}=40\text{ cm}$
$42\text{ cm}>40\text{ cm}>39\text{ cm}$
The $42$ cm plant is tallest.

foundation.question_text: Which ribbon is longest: $3.4$ m, $325$ cm or $3500$ mm?
foundation.solution_text:
$3.4\text{ m}=340\text{ cm}$
$3500\text{ mm}=350\text{ cm}$
$350\text{ cm}>340\text{ cm}>325\text{ cm}$
The $3500$ mm ribbon is longest.

development.question_text: Which shelf is longer: $1.05$ m or $104$ cm?
development.solution_text:
$1.05\text{ m}=105\text{ cm}$
$105\text{ cm}>104\text{ cm}$
The $1.05$ m shelf is longer.

development.question_text: Which route is longer: $2.07$ km or $2090$ m?
development.solution_text:
$2.07\text{ km}=2070\text{ m}$
$2070\text{ m}<2090\text{ m}$
The $2090$ m route is longer.

development.question_text: Which model track is longest: $980$ mm, $1.03$ m or $99$ cm?
development.solution_text:
$1.03\text{ m}=1030\text{ mm}$
$99\text{ cm}=990\text{ mm}$
$1030\text{ mm}>990\text{ mm}>980\text{ mm}$
The $1.03$ m track is longest.

development.question_text: Which beam is longest: $0.675$ m, $680$ mm or $67$ cm?
development.solution_text:
$0.675\text{ m}=675\text{ mm}$
$67\text{ cm}=670\text{ mm}$
$680\text{ mm}>675\text{ mm}>670\text{ mm}$
The $680$ mm beam is longest.

development.question_text: Which walking route is longer: $0.98$ km or $985$ m?
development.solution_text:
$0.98\text{ km}=980\text{ m}$
$980\text{ m}<985\text{ m}$
The $985$ m route is longer.

development.question_text: Which cable is longest: $0.735$ m, $73$ cm or $740$ mm?
development.solution_text:
$0.735\text{ m}=735\text{ mm}$
$73\text{ cm}=730\text{ mm}$
$740\text{ mm}>735\text{ mm}>730\text{ mm}$
The $740$ mm cable is longest.

mastery.question_text: Which distance is longest: $1.203$ km, $1208$ m, $120500$ cm or $1206000$ mm?
mastery.solution_text:
$1.203\text{ km}=1203\text{ m}$
$120500\text{ cm}=1205\text{ m}$
$1206000\text{ mm}=1206\text{ m}$
$1208\text{ m}>1206\text{ m}>1205\text{ m}>1203\text{ m}$
The $1208$ m distance is longest.

mastery.question_text: Which distance is longest: $0.0987$ km, $98.6$ m, $9880$ cm or $98750$ mm?
mastery.solution_text:
$0.0987\text{ km}=98.7\text{ m}$
$9880\text{ cm}=98.8\text{ m}$
$98750\text{ mm}=98.75\text{ m}$
$98.8\text{ m}>98.75\text{ m}>98.7\text{ m}>98.6\text{ m}$
The $9880$ cm distance is longest.

mastery.question_text: Which beam is longest: $201.4$ cm, $2015$ mm, $2.013$ m or $0.002016$ km?
mastery.solution_text:
$201.4\text{ cm}=2014\text{ mm}$
$2.013\text{ m}=2013\text{ mm}$
$0.002016\text{ km}=2.016\text{ m}=2016\text{ mm}$
$2016\text{ mm}>2015\text{ mm}>2014\text{ mm}>2013\text{ mm}$
The $0.002016$ km beam is longest.
